summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its vehicle delivery results for April 2026, including a 13% month-over-month increase to 31,011 vehicles delivered. The press release also discusses the unveiling of a new SUV (XPENG GX) and the rollout of locally produced P7+ vehicles at Magna's plant in Austria. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital returns. This is a routine operational update with no deal terms or structural changes.
